info.description: Management and WASM code execution API. Successful JSON responses use a data envelope; errors contain msg. All HTTP bodies are capped by app.wasm_limits.max_request_bytes; oversized bodies return HTTP 413. Buffered bodies share app.wasm_limits.max_buffered_request_bytes; requests that exceed it return HTTP 503.
info.title: Elaina API
